about: A small, hand-written, fictional knowledge base for 'Harbour Bank'. Queries and their relevant document ids were labelled before any retriever was run.

docs.title: Annual leave
docs.text: Permanent staff receive an annual leave entitlement of 25 working days per calendar year. Up to five unused days may be carried over into the next year with line manager approval.

docs.title: Sick leave
docs.text: Employees who are unwell must notify their line manager before 09:00. A medical certificate is required for absences longer than two consecutive working days.

docs.title: Parental leave
docs.text: Birth parents are entitled to sixteen weeks of paid parental leave. Partners receive four weeks of paid leave, which may be taken within six months of the birth or adoption.

docs.title: Expense claims
docs.text: Business expenses must be claimed within 60 days through the expenses portal. Attach an itemised receipt for every item above the equivalent of 20 US dollars.

docs.title: Travel booking
docs.text: All flights and hotels for business trips are booked through the travel desk. Economy class is standard for flights under six hours; business class requires executive approval.

docs.title: Error TX-4471
docs.text: Error TX-4471 is raised by the payments gateway when a beneficiary account fails sanctions screening. The payment is held and routed to the financial crime operations queue.

docs.title: Error TX-4417
docs.text: Error TX-4417 indicates that a SWIFT message failed schema validation. Correct the field formatting and resubmit; no compliance review is triggered.

docs.title: Policy HR-208 remote work
docs.text: Policy HR-208 allows hybrid working of up to three days per week from home. Staff working remotely must use the corporate VPN and a bank-issued laptop.

docs.title: Policy IS-112 passwords
docs.text: Policy IS-112 requires passphrases of at least 14 characters and multi-factor authentication for all systems that hold customer data.

docs.title: Data classification
docs.text: Information is classified as public, internal, confidential or restricted. Restricted data, such as customer account numbers, may only be stored in approved systems in-country.

docs.title: Model risk management
docs.text: Every model used in a credit or pricing decision must be registered in the model inventory, independently validated before use, and re-validated at least annually.

docs.title: Generative AI acceptable use
docs.text: Staff may use approved generative AI assistants for drafting and summarising. Confidential or restricted information must not be pasted into public chatbots.

docs.title: Incident reporting
docs.text: Suspected security incidents, including phishing emails and lost devices, must be reported to the security operations centre within one hour of discovery.

docs.title: Gifts and entertainment
docs.text: Gifts from clients worth more than 100 US dollars must be declared in the gifts register within five working days. Cash gifts must always be refused.

docs.title: Whistleblowing
docs.text: Concerns about fraud, bribery or misconduct can be raised anonymously through the independent ethics hotline. Retaliation against whistleblowers is a disciplinary offence.

docs.title: Performance reviews
docs.text: Performance conversations take place twice a year. Ratings are calibrated across teams before bonuses are confirmed in March.

docs.title: Training requirements
docs.text: Mandatory compliance training on anti-money laundering, sanctions and data protection must be completed every year by 30 June.

docs.title: Know your customer
docs.text: New corporate clients must provide proof of registration, ultimate beneficial ownership and the identity of directors before an account can be opened.

docs.title: Payments cut-off times
docs.text: Same-day domestic payments must be submitted before 15:30. International payments submitted after 14:00 are processed on the next business day.

docs.title: Laptop and device policy
docs.text: Bank-issued laptops are encrypted and centrally managed. Personal devices may access email only through the approved mobile management application.

docs.title: Retention of records
docs.text: Transaction records and client correspondence are retained for at least seven years after the relationship ends, unless a legal hold applies.

docs.title: Conflicts of interest
docs.text: Employees must disclose outside business interests, directorships and close relationships with clients or suppliers to compliance before they start.

docs.title: Overtime and time off in lieu
docs.text: Hours worked beyond the contracted week may be taken later as time off in lieu, agreed with the line manager, rather than paid as overtime.

docs.title: Public holidays
docs.text: Offices close on national public holidays. Staff required to work on a public holiday receive a replacement day of rest.
